hit.pose: Initial incoming impact from WEST, shoulders beginning to recoil screen RIGHT, protective near LEFT flask at chest, far RIGHT lamp at lower ribs.

Incoming force increases from screen LEFT. Through spinal articulation move shoulders/head about20 native pixels RIGHT relative to pelvis; slightly deepen both knees without moving either planted shoe. Eyes tightly shut and chin retracts. Near left bottle pressed chest, far right lamp braced, no full-image shift.

Clear recoil PEAK: shoulders/chest lean BACK toward screen RIGHT about12 degrees from upright relative to stationary pelvis, head follows right/back50px through neck/spine, knees visibly flex to absorb force. Both shoe support positions and their LEFT pointing axes must remain EXACT. Face strains eyes closed; near LEFT bottle protected; far RIGHT lantern arm flexes. Not a whole-image translation, not a fall.

Rebound after peak: straighten chest halfway toward upright, knees remain compressed; one eye starts opening. Head returns LEFT toward guard via spinal joint. Planted feet exact. Bottle chest, lantern guard slightly lowers, hair/tassels delayed.

Recovery: body nearly upright over same shoes, knees part extend, eyes now open looking WEST, right lamp arm relaxes slightly, near left bottle remains chest. Not another impact. Keep stable west shoe long axes.
Final recovered guard: body upright, knees unlocked, calm WEST gaze, near left bottle chest, far right lamp slightly forward-low. Settled cloth/hair. Distinct new frame from01; no wince, no run.

attack.pose: Compact initial readiness: near LEFT flask chest, far RIGHT elbow folds close far ribs drawing lantern grip slightly inward/down at abdomen; no rearward near-arm stretch. Stable west-facing guard.

Load short attack: knees flex a little, far RIGHT elbow draws grip close body midline, lamp bowl in front-left of abdomen, near LEFT bottle remains fixed chest. This is compact loading before push, not backswing crossing body.

Anticipation peak: weight on rear shoe, knees compressed, far RIGHT hand with lamp drawn closest to far waist; slightly raise wrist and tilt lamp, elbow visibly folded. Near LEFT bottle still chest. Compact charged pose.

Begin swing: far RIGHT shoulder rotates forward WEST, elbow moves out from ribs and wrist extends about35px LEFT; lantern just starting forward arc. Near LEFT bottle arm frozen at chest. Feet planted.

Accelerate: far RIGHT elbow partly opens; lamp wrist advances70px LEFT of loading position at chest height. Lean torso forward WEST4degrees over planted front foot. Lamp complete inside left margin >45px, original size. Near LEFT bottle secured.

Contact: far RIGHT lamp arm reaches forward WEST almost straight but not locked, short curved handle/palm visibly connected far shoulder. Lamp bowl forward-left near x210,y750; maintain entire tassel within canvas and above floor. Near LEFT bottle at chest unchanged. Front knee braces, rear foot drives; no VFX.

Follow-through: far RIGHT lantern continues a short forward/down arc; wrist lowers slightly, torso maintains short WEST lean. Front knee absorbs, rear heel can lift slightly while toe stays same place LEFT-directed. Do not reach left canvas edge. Near LEFT bottle protected.
Brake: far RIGHT elbow starts bending inward with lamp still forward; chest begins returning upright, front knee compresses, rear heel down. Near LEFT bottle same chest location. Not swap hands.
Retract: far RIGHT grip folds toward lower ribs, bringing lamp closer front-left waist. Torso neutralizes. Near LEFT bottle fixed chest, feet exact.
Recover: shoulders upright, far RIGHT lamp hand at body-side front waist, near LEFT flask upper abdomen. Knees relax but feet remain same.
Guard return: far right shoulder relaxes, elbow gently bent, lamp almost still. Near left flask protected, WEST gaze alert, cloth settling, no walk.
Final guard: balanced standing WEST, near LEFT flask, far RIGHT lantern at front-left waist clear of shoes, all movement settled. Same head/feet coordinates; no duplicated source.

cast.pose: Quiet gathering initial state, near LEFT flask chest, far RIGHT lamp gently ahead waist.

Lift bottle gathering: near LEFT elbow lifts jade flask only30px toward chest/chin; far RIGHT lamp wrist folds inward slightly. Both hands remain attached original shoulders, no crossing. Concentrated WEST gaze.

Gather inward: near LEFT flask chest, far RIGHT lantern handle moves close to middle-front torso, lamp bowl at abdomen, elbows bent. Chin slightly lowers, knees gently unlock. Near/far hands unchanged.

Compressed gathering: deepen concentration, chin dips and shoulders draw inward a little; near LEFT bottle and far RIGHT lamp converge in front of chest without overlapping their hands. Keep toes LEFT and support fixed.
Lift lantern: far RIGHT wrist raises original lamp from abdomen toward chest height while elbow remains bent; near LEFT bottle at sternum. No release yet; slight upward glance WEST.
Preparation middle: far RIGHT lamp hand rises a little more, lamp bowl before upper waist; near LEFT bottle stays protected chest. Both elbows still flexed, no maximum extension yet.

Pre-release: far RIGHT shoulder begins WEST-forward, wrist about40px LEFT of prior gather, elbow partly opens. Near LEFT bottle held at chest EXACTLY. Lamp stays same size/short hook, no swapped sleeve.
Release starts: far RIGHT lantern wrist extends farther screen LEFT and slightly up, still more bent than peak. Near LEFT bottle remains chest, its shoulder and arm unchanged. No VFX.

Release peak: far RIGHT arm reaches forward WEST slightly upward, lamp bowl forward-left at chest height; elbow almost extended. NEAR LEFT hand keeps single jade flask firmly at chest, clear anatomical ownership. No huge effects, no projectile. Stable shoes LEFT.
Hold release: far RIGHT elbow softens slightly from peak and wrist drops30px, lamp still in front at chest. Near LEFT bottle remains chest. Face concentrated, support fixed.
Release ends: far RIGHT shoulder lowers, elbow begins folding inward, lantern still forward but lower. Near LEFT bottle relaxes to sternum. Knees relax.
Retract both: far RIGHT elbow returns close far ribs bringing lamp front-left waist, near LEFT bottle secured chest. Body upright WEST side, feet same, no crossing/swapping hands.
Recovery at chest-side: far RIGHT grip just forward of lower ribs, lamp at waist; near LEFT flask against upper abdomen. Hair/sleeves slight lag. No glow outside lamp.
Settle shoulders: far RIGHT elbow relaxed and lamp handle a little lower, near LEFT bottle comfortably chest. Calm alert WEST gaze. Same planted shoe axis.
Almost settled: far RIGHT lamp nearly motionless before hip, near LEFT bottle torso, knees unlocked. Tiny cloth lag; lamp tassel ends above shoe/floor region. Independent pose.

Final recovered cast guard: calm WEST gaze, upright balanced torso, near LEFT hand holds bottle at chest, far RIGHT arm naturally bent with lamp front-left waist. All action ended, native independent pose, no copy.
